title: Willis Young as schoolteacher to his own children
summary: Young held school every day for Lester, Lee and Irma and taught no one else.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Also, we missed this before we turned over the tape. You mentioned that Willis Young went down to New Orleans, and the kids, Lester, Irma and Lee, were living with their mother...
Yeah.
And he took them out, and then he put them in show business when Lester was about ten years old.
Yeah. That's not on there.
It's on there now. We just got it on there. We missed that before.
Yeah. And from then on...
From then on? Was that before you joined?

Oh yeah. See, what he did... See, he had degrees to teach school, too. He taught them, until they went to high school. But he taught them. He started them off in school. Every day they had to go to class with him.
With Willis Young.
Yes.
Just his kids. You mean Lee...
Just his kids. Lee and Irma and Lester.
Phillips - 32
Lee, Irma and Lester, three kids.
Yes.
And that's the only kids there were, right?
Yeah, he taught them. Every day they'd get... When I got with him, he said, "All right, come on. It's school time."
He used to say that when you joined?
Yeah. He would still be teaching them.
Did he ever teach you any?
No.
Just them.
